title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README for the portfolio's React and Vite stack, route map, content model, and delivery workflow. It gives the context needed to connect the application shell, reusable views, and the project checks that follow.

title: Build and Tooling
description: The package manifest and Vite configuration define how the application is developed, tested, and built. Read these before the UI because they establish the runtime dependencies and production build boundary for the rest of the tour.

title: Application Bootstrap
description: The React entry point starts the client application, while App composes the top-level experience. Together they form the application-shell layer that brings global state and page composition into the browser.
languageLesson: React entry points mount a component tree into the browser DOM; top-level components then establish shared providers and the application's composition boundary.

title: Portfolio Composition
description: Main is the presentation-layer coordinator that brings the portfolio's primary sections together. It is the useful bridge between the bootstrap files and the individual page and component modules explored next.

title: Content Data Model
description: The shared portfolio module and project data keep portfolio content separate from rendering code. This lets page components present structured content consistently rather than embedding project details throughout the UI.

title: Reusable Navigation
description: Header is one of the most connected presentation components, so it is a good example of shared interface infrastructure. Study it before page-specific views to see how global navigation supports the portfolio's route structure.

title: Projects Experience
description: The Projects page turns the structured project content into a focused portfolio view. It demonstrates how the presentation layer consumes the content-data layer introduced in the previous steps.

title: Theme System
description: The theme registry defines palette and family resolution, while the controller exposes selection and persistence through React context. The theme page then provides an interactive way to inspect the active presentation choices across components.
languageLesson: React context shares state such as the active theme without passing props through every intermediate component; a provider owns the value and consumers read it where needed.

title: Quality and Delivery
description: The test utilities and behavior suite show how the application verifies browser-facing behavior, while the CI and deployment workflows automate validation and publication. This closes the tour by connecting implementation work to repeatable quality checks and the GitHub Pages release path.
languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows combine event triggers, jobs, and ordered steps so the same lint, test, build, and deployment process can run consistently outside a developer machine.
